title: Boolean affine refinement compatible with finitely many closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be an affine Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning it is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $C_1,\ldots,C_r\hookrightarrow X$ be finitely many closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. There is a finite family of immersions $R_\alpha\hookrightarrow X$ whose images are pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] covering $X$, with every $R_\alpha$ affine and reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], such that for every $\alpha,j$ the pullback $C_j\times_XR_\alpha\to R_\alpha$ [def-pc-fibre-product] has either empty underlying space or underlying space all of $R_\alpha$.
